About · Acerca de Pollito Productions

Pollito Productions is a set of free Spanish learning games and tools, built by a Spanish teacher for his own students first — and now open to anyone learning Spanish.

Everything here runs on the same idea: the games, the practice tools, and Pollito the tutor are one product. Play a game to meet the words, use a tool to practice the grammar, then chat with Pollito to put it together.

The games and tools are free, with no ads on either version, and your progress is saved on your own device — no account needed.

Visit pollitoproductions.github.io.

Questions, feedback, or a correction? Email Brant at bfuller@haydenschools.org.

Privacy · Política de privacidad

Privacy Policy — the short, plain version.

No accounts, no sign-up. The games and tools work without registering, and we don't ask for names, emails, or passwords.

Progress stays on your device. Scores, streaks, and saved games are stored locally in your browser or app — they are not sent to us.

  • We do not sell personal information.
  • Speaking practice uses your device's own speech features; we don't keep recordings.
  • This website shows no ads. The Android app may show ads through Google AdMob, which can use cookies and device identifiers as described in Google's own privacy policy.

Questions about privacy can be sent through the contact information on this site, pollitoproductions.github.io.
